title: L2 CAD: drive CSMA from CadDone IRQ instead of blocking lichen_lora_cad_run()
description:
Child of parent project-LICHEN-worker6-9hfe (async LoRa API refactor).

Scope (files): lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c (CAD registry + lichen_lora_cad_run() at :62), CAD handling in lichen/drivers/lora/lr1110/lr1110.c (+ lora_sim.c / lora_renode.c emulation parity IF driver-level CAD plumbing is missing), hook point consumed by lichen/subsys/lichen/link/csma.c.

Work:
1. Audit driver CAD support: check whether lr1110.c IRQ mask/status handles CadDone and whether any async CAD entry point exists (rg -n 'cad|Cad' lichen/drivers/lora/). If missing, add a driver-level async CAD API (start CAD + CadDone IRQ -> callback) mirroring the send_async/recv_async pattern in the lora_driver_api struct (lr1110.c:718-720), with parity in lora_sim.c and lora_renode.c.
2. Replace blocking lichen_lora_cad_run() (polls CAD with k_timeout_t, lora_l2_tx.c:62) with: start CAD, return; CadDone callback computes (cad_status, channel_busy) and invokes the registered lichen_lora_cad_fn callback (cad_registry at lora_l2_tx.c:30) — the existing callback contract matches lichen_csma_cad_fn consumed by csma.c:290-331.
3. CSMA integration: lichen_csma_cad_begin()/lichen_csma_cad_complete() (csma.c:125,147) already model begin/complete transitions — wire the async CAD callback into lichen_csma_cad_complete() with LICHEN_CSMA_RESULT_CAD_BUSY/CAD_TIMEOUT outcomes (csma.c:210-211). No polling loop, no sleeps; backoff via existing state machine.
4. Keep cad_registry thread-safe (cad_registry_mutex at lora_l2_tx.c:31); CadDone callback is ISR context — defer to workqueue if the callback contract requires thread context, document which.

Acceptance: rg -n 'lichen_lora_cad_run' shows no blocking wait-loop; CAD outcomes (busy/timeout/clear) exercised in lichen/tests/csma and lichen/tests/csma_constants; sim driver demonstrates async CAD completion in a test. Depends on B (TX path owns lora_l2_tx.c; CAD gates TX channel access).
close_reason: Verified all acceptance items in-tree; no code changes needed (implementation landed via children vdaq/gygz/dzyt + 0lm8). (1) No blocking wait-loop: grep -rn lichen_lora_cad_run lichen/ = zero hits; CSMA is driven by the async CAD registry (lichen_lora_cad_start/cad_done) + csma_cad_probe bounded-k_poll continuation, emulated sysworkq completion for sim/renode (lora_sim.c:487, lora_renode.c:306). (2) CAD outcomes busy/timeout/clear exercised in lichen/tests/csma (test_canonical_backoff_and_clear, test_exponent_mapping_timeout_and_exhaustion, test_acquire_clear_busy_timeout_error_and_cancel) and csma_constants: fresh local gcc/cmake builds, ctest 1/1 PASS each on this Linux host. (3) Sim driver async CAD completion demonstrated in ping_l2 test_async_cad_emulated_completion (emulated path + K_NO_WAIT lapse -ETIMEDOUT classification). (4) Callback context documented at lora_l2_tx.c:125-130 (thread/work context only, non-blocking, under cad_registry_mutex). native_sim execution attempted on local 4.1.0 workspace; blocked by documented 4.1.0/v3.7.0 split issues unrelated to CAD (twister drops prj.conf; b7z9.92 schc CMake fatal) - evidence commented on b7z9.92; pinned v3.7.0 CI owns execution. No files touched, so 3x codereview N/A.
